literal: I will indeed hide my love, I? Without warning, like a sneeze, appearing it will escape.
translation: I try indeed to hide my love, but like a sneeze, it bursts forth suddenly without warning.
modern: நான் என் காமத்தை மறைக்கவே நினைக்கிறேன்; ஆனால் அது, ஒரு தும்மலைப் போல, எந்தவித முன்னறிவிப்பும் இல்லாமல் திடீரென்று வெளிப்பட்டு விடுகிறது.
explanation: The heroine laments her inability to conceal her intense love-sickness. She asserts that she tries her best to hide her feelings ('மறைப்பேன்'). However, love is not something that can be suppressed by willpower. It is compared to a sneeze ('தும்மல்'), which cannot be stopped or anticipated; it bursts out suddenly without warning ('குறிப்பின்றி'). Just as a sneeze reveals itself despite one's efforts to hold it back, her love reveals itself to others, rendering her attempts at secrecy futile.
